body:
## Pull request overview

This PR resolves TypeScript compilation errors in the CI build across four packages. The errors stem from: (1) ag-grid 35.x API changes, (2) incorrect dependency placement in plugin packages, (3) missing type annotations causing implicit `any` errors, and (4) improper tsconfig path mapping overrides.

**Changes:**
- Fixed ag-grid 35.x context menu return type change from `string` to `DefaultMenuItem` union type
- Moved `@object-ui/*` dependencies from `peerDependencies` to `dependencies` in plugin-ai and plugin-workflow (matching the pattern used in plugin-grid, plugin-form, plugin-kanban, etc.)
- Added explicit TypeScript type annotations to event handlers and callback parameters across all affected components
- Removed tsconfig.json path mapping overrides that shadowed root configuration
- Fixed InMemoryDriver type mismatch with `_id` property access using `any` cast

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `apps/console/src/mocks/createKernel.ts` | Cast result to `any` for `_id` property access (InMemoryDriver type doesn't include `_id` but protocol requires it) |
| `packages/plugin-aggrid/src/ObjectAgGridImpl.tsx` | Updated context menu return type to `(DefaultMenuItem \| MenuItemDef)[]` for ag-grid 35.x compatibility; added `DefaultMenuItem` import |
| `packages/plugin-ai/tsconfig.json` | Removed redundant `baseUrl`/`paths` overrides that shadowed root tsconfig |
| `packages/plugin-ai/package.json` | Moved `@object-ui/*` from `peerDependencies` to `dependencies` (aligns with plugin-grid/form/kanban pattern) |
| `packages/plugin-ai/src/NLQueryInput.tsx` | Added explicit types to map callbacks; wrapped unknown cell values in `String()` for safe rendering |
| `packages/plugin-ai/src/AIRecommendations.tsx` | Added `React.MouseEvent` type to onClick handler |
| `packages/plugin-workflow/package.json` | Moved `@object-ui/*` from `peerDependencies` to `dependencies` |
| `packages/plugin-workflow/src/FlowDesigner.tsx` | Added explicit `React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>` and `string` types to all event handlers |
| `packages/plugin-workflow/src/AutomationBuilder.tsx` | Added explicit `string` type annotations to all `onValueChange` handlers |
| `packages/plugin-workflow/src/ApprovalProcess.tsx` | Added explicit `React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>` type to onChange handler |
</details>
